name: zrndr_span_occlusion_submit_occluder_rect
description: zRndr::SpanOcclusionSubmitOccluderRect converts a HUD rect to a four-vertex occluder polygon.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zRndr span-occlusion pass because x87 scheduling and broader span source context are expected to affect isolated byte shape.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x490610 validates integer rect-to-float vertex setup, optional 0.5 scaling when halveIfReplicate is nonzero, uniform z assignment, and tail call to SpanOcclusionAddPolygon(vertices, 4).
Native smoke zrndr_span_occlusion_submit_rect_smoke verifies the saved occluder polygon vertices for both normal and replicated half-scale paths.
